children: , expanding its commercial scope beyond Panama into four additional Latin American markets: Argentina, Venezuela, Colombia, and Costa Rica.

Alongside the territorial expansion, the amended agreement adds TempraMed’s VIVI Med™ to the covered product portfolio, joining existing products VIVI Cap™ and VIVI Epi™. VIVI Med™ expands the company’s passive temperature-protection platform from standard insulin pens to include vials, biologics, and other temperature-sensitive medical supplies.
In connection with the amendment, TempraMed received an additional commercial order from TEM, which is scheduled for fulfillment by the end of September 2026.
TEM will be responsible for all regulatory filings, importation approvals, and commercialization costs across the newly added territories.
Separately, TempraMed announced a non-brokered private placement to raise gross proceeds of up to C$1.0M. The offering consists of up to 2M units priced at C$0.50 per unit.
Each unit comprises one common share and one 18-month share purchase warrant exercisable at C$1.00.
Net proceeds will be used for new inventory, product development, global sales and marketing expansion, and general working capital.
The offering is expected to close on or before September 30, 2026.
